items.verseEn: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

items.verse: ۞ أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?

items.verse: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?

items.verse: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
items.verseEn: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.

categories.name: أَحْدَاثُ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ فِي سُورَةِ ٱلتَّكْوِيرِ
categories.nameEn: Events of the Day of Judgment in Surah At-Takwir

items.verseEn: And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the souls are paired
And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
And when the sky is stripped away

categories.name: كَيْفِيَّةُ أَخْذِ الْكِتَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
categories.nameEn: The Manner of Receiving the Record on Judgment Day

items.verse: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
items.verseEn: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

items.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
items.verseEn: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

items.verse: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَـٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًۭا
items.verseEn: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."

items.verse: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
items.verseEn: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

categories.name: مَآ أُنزِلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ
categories.nameEn: Things Sent Down from the Sky

items.verse: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
items.verseEn: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].

items.verse: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

items.verse: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
items.verseEn: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

items.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَرَكَـٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبُوا۟ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
items.verseEn: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allāh, We would have opened [i.e., bestowed] upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning.

harf.hint: Hardship or difficulty, famously paired with its opposite يسر in the Quranic promise that ease follows hardship.

deduction.title: The Truthful Voice of Ancient Times
deduction.intro: There is a soul in the Quran whose story is told in just a few verses, yet their noble qualities shine through with brilliant clarity. Praised by the Almighty for a special virtue, this ancient servant of the Most Merciful holds a place in the pages of revelation. Your task is to identify this remarkable figure. Can you guess who they are?
clues: I am a prophet of Allah who lived among the early generations of humanity.
Allah mentioned me in His Book with other prophets, all praised for the same noble virtue.
I am described as a man of truth in the Quran.
Allah raised me to a high station that few others have attained.
My name is mentioned in Surah Al-Anbiya, grouped with two other prophets praised for their patience.
I am Idris, the truthful and elevated prophet.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Idris
Prophet Nuh
Prophet Ibrahim
Prophet Musa
Prophet Ismail

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Maintaining patience and truthfulness, then elevated to a high station
Building a great ark to save the believers from a devastating flood
Being cast into a blazing fire and emerging completely unharmed
Confronting a mighty king and defeating his army of magicians
Surviving inside the belly of a great fish in the depths of the sea
trial.answer: Maintaining patience and truthfulness, then elevated to a high station

location.label: Key Element
options: A high and exalted station by Allah
A massive ship built from planks and pitched with tar
A raging fire fueled by the idolaters of a wicked king
A vast sea that split into dry paths
The dark belly of a great whale at the bottom of the ocean
location.answer: A high and exalted station by Allah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Admitted into Allah's mercy as one of the righteous
Saved along with all the believers from a worldwide flood
Walked out of the flames untouched by the fire
Led the Children of Israel safely to freedom across the sea
Reunited with their beloved family after long years of hardship
outcome.answer: Admitted into Allah's mercy as one of the righteous

deduction.arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
deduction.verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)

scramble.hint: A powerful opening call to taqwa (God-consciousness) and a warning about the terrifying Day of Judgment at the start of Surah Al-Hajj.
scramble.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
scramble.verseEn: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
